headline: Cybersecurity vets protest ‘dangerous’ US government ban on Anthropic’s most powerful models
context: A group made up of dozens of cybersecurity experts urged the White House to remove export control restrictions on Anthropic’s models Fable and Mythos, arguing that the order is going to limit the ability of cybersecurity defenders to secure their software and products.
